pixelMethod.icc: Embedded ICC profiles converted with PillowImageCms before comparison. Untagged native Figma images and already-normalized comparison sheets assumed sRGB. Alpha composited onwhite.
pixelMethod.metric: Mean absoluteRGB channel difference, range0–255. No similarity percentage is derived.
caveats: Full-board means include large empty backgrounds and can hide local text differences; per-component crop metrics are retained separately.
Browser/Figma antialiasing, font rasterization, CSS layout quantization and shadow rendering leave nonzero residuals.
Animated states can differ by sampled phase; static geometry and actual motion are reviewed separately.
Combined composition sheets are retained for visual inspection without inventing quantitative results.

font.scope: Local licensed design review only; font binaries excluded from this report and Git.

knownVerificationLimits: Literal Figma/browser pixel identity is not certified: measured raster, font antialiasing, shadow and layout-quantization residuals remain in the saved comparisons.
Ambient phases/endpoints are deterministically seeked; a full wall-clock32-second recording and full live6800ms native loop were not captured.
Real document.hidden transition was not observable in Ego. Offscreen phase preservation, reduced motion, cancellation/restart and shared-clock synchronization were observed.
Dark portal/control and390px touch-cover checks cover those exact states; a full mobile or cross-browser product certification is outside this evidence.
